content.short: Parsec Finance enables traversal of transactions, addresses, transfers and blocks in familiar formats.
content.description: The Parsec Explorer is a high-context block explorer. Instead of showing the same data for all address types, it builds a parsec layout tailored to each address. Using a base of 100+ components, the explorer delivers relevant layouts that bring high-fidelity information to the user quickly. Custom layouts are provided for Tokens (chart, trading activity, flows, liquidity, large transfers); EOAs (token flows, funding sources, trading activity); NFTs (chart, top holders, trading activity, collection viewer); Lending Markets (TVL, rates, flows, positions); Liquidity Pools (chart, activity, liquidity depth); Stablecoins (supply over time, lending markets, flows); LSTs (stake over time, rates, peg strength); and ERC4626 yield tokens (yield, deposit flows). The explorer is feature complete with existing explorers.
